name: How long does it take to install new windows in a house?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new windows in a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for new window installation varies based on the number of windows, their type, and the complexity of the project. Generally, it takes one to three days to install windows in an average-sized home. However, custom orders or extensive structural modifications can extend this timeframe. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial assessment, including lead times for window manufacturing and estimated installation duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time depends on the number and type of windows, typically ranging from one to three days for an average house.
